title: PaceReasoner: Label-Free Learning to Answer Briefly from Long Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning improves problem-solving performance but increases inference cost and latency, motivating more accurate answers with shorter reasoning. We introduce PaceReasoner, a label-free test-time reinforcement learning framework that uses a model's LONG responses to improve its SHORT-mode accuracy. Both modes share a trainable policy, creating a need for reliable supervision, sufficient SHORT training samples, and continued LONG responses to guide learning. PaceReasoner combines all-response and LONG-only answer consensus through progressive, confidence-weighted supervision. A behavior reward gradually shifts from encouraging SHORT exploration to rewarding agreement with LONG answers, while a ratio controller regulates the balance between modes. Across three model backbones and four benchmarks, PaceReasoner improves average SHORT accuracy over the baselines by 7.4--13.5 percentage points, with fewer than 25 reas

translated_title: PaceReasoner：从长推理中进行无标签学习以实现简短作答
translated_abstract: 扩展的思维链推理提升了问题求解性能，但增加了推理成本与延迟，这促使人们追求以更短的推理获得更准确的答案。我们提出了PaceReasoner，这是一个无标签的测试时强化学习框架，利用模型自身的长（LONG）响应来提升其短（SHORT）模式的作答准确率。两种模式共享同一个可训练策略，因此需要可靠的监督信号、充足的短模式训练样本，以及持续的长响应来引导学习。PaceReasoner通过渐进式、置信度加权的监督，将全响应答案共识与仅长响应答案共识相结合。其行为奖励从鼓励短模式探索逐渐转变为奖励与长答案的一致性，同时由一个比例控制器调节两种模式之间的平衡。在三个模型骨干和四个基准测试上，PaceReasoner将平均短模式准确率较基线提升了7.4–13.5个百分点，且使用的推理（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: PaceReasoner提出了一种无标签的测试时强化学习框架，通过置信度加权的渐进监督和奖励-比例控制机制，让模型从自身的长推理中学习，从而以更短的推理获得更高的作答准确率（平均提升7.4–13.5个百分点）。
en_tdlr: PaceReasoner is a label-free test-time reinforcement learning framework that uses progressive confidence-weighted supervision and reward-ratio control to distill a model's long reasoning into more accurate short answers, improving SHORT-mode accuracy by 7.4–13.5 percentage points on average.
